description: This is a Java test class for the NotesServerSyncTask in the Nextcloud Notes Android client project. It contains unit tests for synchronizing notes between local storage and remote server, utilizing Mockito for mocking dependencies and Robolectric for Android environment simulation.

classes.name: NotesServerSyncTaskTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the NotesServerSyncTask's synchronization logic, including pushing local changes and pulling remote changes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks dependencies, and creates an instance of NotesServerSyncTask.

methods.name: testPushLocalChanges
methods.description: Tests that local notes marked as edited are correctly pushed to the server, verifying create and update operations.

methods.name: testPullRemoteChanges
methods.description: Tests that remote notes are correctly pulled and integrated locally, verifying add and update operations.
